authored_description_preserved: A shard of the dark obelisk. Any creature which it bleeds will fall into an endless nightmare. It can only be used once.
legacy_only: Choose an adjacent living creature. The shard is consumed only on success.
Use on an adjacent living creature, or equip in either hand to use on your next melee target. No accuracy roll; prevents revival. Consumed only after a successful use.
note: Legacy instructions remain for explicit historical revisions33–38 only. No old unknown-origin labels are relabeled as user-authored.
